fullDescription: A vibrant, modern social media management dashboard style featuring a fixed left-sidebar layout. The design utilizes a high-energy palette of pink, purple, and orange gradients (Paper Gradient) contrasted against clean white cards and a light gray background (#f5f5f5). It employs the Satoshi typeface for a premium, tech-forward feel. Suitable for SaaS dashboards, creator tools, fintech platforms, and marketing analytics suites. Key characteristics include rounded-2xl corners (16px-24px), glassmorphism effects (backdrop-blur-xl), and sophisticated soft shadows.

structured.summary: A clean, high-fidelity PC dashboard with a fixed 280px sidebar, featuring a vibrant pink/purple primary color scheme, editorial typography, and high-contrast 'connection' status cards.

style.description: The style is defined by its use of the Satoshi font family, a specific 'Paper Gradient' (purple to pink to orange), and soft elevation. Primary color is #FF6B9D (Pilot Pink) with accents of #B366FF (Pilot Purple) and #FF8A65 (Pilot Orange). UI elements use a generous border radius (16px+), subtle 1px gray borders (#E5E7EB), and backdrop-blur effects on sticky elements.
style.prompt: Create a design system using the 'Satoshi' font family. Primary palette: Pilot Pink (#FF6B9D), Pilot Purple (#B366FF), and Pilot Orange (#FF8A65). Use a background color of #F5F5F5. Typography specs: Headings (30px, 600 weight, tight tracking), Subheadings (22px-26px, 600 weight), Body (16px-18px). Implement a 'Paper Gradient' as a linear-gradient(135deg, #B366FF 0%, #FF6B9D 48%, #FF8A65 100%). Use a 'Soft Shadow' (0 18px 50px rgba(40, 40, 60, 0.08)). All container corners should be rounded to 1rem (16px) or 1.5rem (24px). Interactive elements should have a 150ms ease-in-out transition for hover states (background-color and shadow changes).

layout_and_structure.description: A classic dashboard architecture consisting of a fixed-width left sidebar (280px) and a main content area that scrolls independently. The main content is split into a header and a grid-based body (typically 1.25fr to 0.95fr for a main-feed/side-info dynamic).

prompts.prompt: Fixed sidebar, width: 280px, height: 100vh. Background: white/90% with backdrop-blur-xl. Border-right: 1px solid #E5E7EB. Include a 92px high logo area. Navigation items should be 56px high (h-14) with 20px padding, 16px border-radius. Active state: Pink text (#FF6B9D), gradient background (Pink-50 to Purple-50), and 1px pink border. Inactive state: Gray-500 text, hover effect to light pink background.

Height: 92px. Background: White. Border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E7EB. Layout: Flex-row with space-between. Left side: Title group with 14px secondary label and 30px primary heading. Right side: Action button using the 'Paper Gradient' (purple-pink-orange), white text, 44px height.

Padding: 32px horizontally, 24px vertically. Layout: 2-column grid (60/40 split on large screens). Left column: Vertical stack of feature cards (spacing 20px). Right column: Profile/Analytics summary card that sticks to the top. Use a gap of 20px between all major sections.

special_ui_components.description: A high-visibility card indicating active service connections.
special_ui_components.prompt: Height: 112px. Border-radius: 12px. Background: White to Pink-50 gradient. Border: 1px solid #FF6B9D. Inner circle: 72px diameter, using 'Paper Gradient', containing a large white icon (42px). Text: 22px semi-bold title, 20px semi-bold status label in Pilot Pink.

special_ui_components.description: A stylized user profile card located at the bottom of the navigation.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: rounded-2xl, border 1px solid pink-100, background gradient (Pink-50 to Purple-50). Elements: 44px circular avatar, 16px bold username, 14px 'connected' status text in #EC4899.

special_ui_components.description: An aside component mimicking a social media profile layout.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: white card, 1px border. Header: 150px circular avatar, stats grid (Posts/Followers/Following) with 23px medium weight numbers. Body: Multi-line bio (17px text), blue link with pink icon. Footer: 3-column tab bar with large icons and 2px active indicator. Content: 3-column square image grid with 8px gaps.

structured.special_notes: MUST use Satoshi font for the premium aesthetic. DO NOT use sharp corners; minimum radius is 8px for small buttons, 16-24px for cards. DO NOT use heavy black borders; use #E5E7EB or #D1D5DB for subtle definition. MUST ensure icons are large (approx 28-30px) to match the bold typography.
